changes.to: Buttons, links and the active tab's text use the palette's link teal (#1f7a6f light, #5cc8ba dark) instead of the main teal #2a9d8f: white on #2a9d8f is 3.3:1, below WCAG AA (4.5:1) that the task asks for; #1f7a6f gives 5.0:1 and dark #5cc8ba with navy text 8.9:1. #2a9d8f marks focus rings and the chosen tab and range underline (3.2:1, enough for non-text)
